weak_rule_falsified.falsification: The status explicitly allows an execution race or already-started execution. F5 CAS controls repository finalization authority only; it supplies no provider-side evidence that an irreversible effect is absent. Therefore the rule is unsafe within this fixture.

observations: Cancellation-request acknowledgement and cancellation-before-execution are distinct evidence classes.
Current-fence CAS/readback is necessary for repository authority but cannot substitute for provider-side outcome evidence.

For a negative closure derived from event absence, completeness/sealed-history semantics are part of the evidence minimum; an incomplete log with no start event is not proof that execution never started.
inference: For this exact self-local fixture, cancellation_requested plus F5 CAS/readback is insufficient for safe non-effect closure. The minimum missing provider-side obligation is exact-identity evidence proving both absence of irreversible effect and impossibility of later execution. This can be satisfied by a documented terminal no-effect assertion or by an equivalent complete and sealed execution-history/attempt proof, but not by a request acknowledgement or ambiguous status label alone.
